scope: Revalidate GTK2 scrollbar stepper normal/held/released rendering in the three alternate KDE color schemes after the palette painter change.
method: Ran the actual GTK2 2.24.33 separate preview in private Xvfb/bwrap environments with the current project recipes. Captured horizontal and vertical arrows in normal, mouse-held, and released states at scale factor 1; verified each 15x15 arrow cell and palette-role pixels against the same scheme's generated assets.
limits: This confirms GTK2 runtime parity with generated assets and working held/released interaction in these schemes; it does not establish historical VUE pressed-state fidelity.
No theme profile, user application, XChat process, or MAME guest was changed or restarted.
The earlier BreezeClassic test wrapper initially missed a Python import path; its already captured output was validated successfully before this clean matrix was run.
